description: Cross-language pHash parity for F-025 Similar Photos. Inputs: 32x32 8-bit grayscale matrices (row-major). Expected: produced by the real Swift DCT/median code (scripts/phash-parity-swift.swift, verified identical to Halo/Core/Scanner/PerceptualDuplicateDetector.swift). Hash bit i (MSB first) = coefficient (y=i/8, x=i%8) > median of the 63 AC terms.
